name: Government Data Centre (GDC/Neyduetewa)
notes: asset_class=government/sovereign hosting. DCD reports Bhutan opened its first government data center (2,500 sq ft, Tier II design, at Bhutan Innovation & Technology Centre in Thimphu TechPark); ITU 2023 GovTech presentation says GDC operationalized in 2017, colocated ~1,000 sq ft GDC space with 2,500 sq ft leased to DCS, hosting 200+ government systems by 2023. MW capacity not public.

name: Data Centre Services (DCS) Internet Data Centre
notes: asset_class=commercial colo/IDC. DCS official site and Thimphu TechPark confirm Tier 2/3 Internet Data Centre inside Thimphu TechPark with high power density, hydro-powered zero-carbon cooling and dual power feeders (Olakha/Semtokha substations per methodology); commercial colocation/hosting/backup/connectivity. Rack/MW capacity not publicly stated.

name: btIX Bhutan Internet Exchange
notes: asset_class=internet exchange (interconnection, not a datacenter by itself). PeeringDB ix/2355, AS7615 BTIX-AS-AP and btIX site place the exchange at Thimphu TechPark, Wangchuktaba Babesa, Thimphu. Operational IX for Bhutan telecom/ISP community.

name: Bitdeer Gedu data center
notes: asset_class=crypto/mining datacenter (not commercial colo). Bitdeer official datacenter page lists Gedu, Bhutan 100 MW; Bitdeer January 31, 2026 infrastructure summary lists Gedu as online (reported by coincu); DCD covered 2023 construction completion, Bitdeer's first Asia facility, ~30,000 mining machines / ~3.3 EH/s per Baxtel. Capacity is electrical/mining MW, not IT load.

name: Bitdeer Jigmeling data center
developer: Bitdeer Technologies Group (Bitdeer Jigmeling Pvt. Ltd.)
notes: asset_class=crypto/mining datacenter. Bitdeer launched the 500 MW Jigmeling facility (second project, March 2024 per bitdeer.com; phased operations started 1 Apr 2025 per BBS) and its Jan 31 2026 infrastructure summary lists Jigmeling as online; Kuensel reports full-scale operations targeted for 2026. Do not record as merely planned; capacity is electrical/mining MW, not IT load.

name: SATO-GMCA AI Compute Campus (Gelephu Mindfulness City)
developer: SATO Technologies Corp. / Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority (GMCA)
notes: asset_class=planned AI/GPU campus. LOI effective 2026-06-20, announced 2026-07-06, for a hydro-powered sovereign AI compute campus in Gelephu Mindfulness City (Sarpang): initial ~5 MW, target ~100 MW firm renewable power, possible 500 MW pathway - all planning claims, not operating capacity. Status stays planned/LOI until GMCA publishes land lease, construction or power-allocation evidence.

name: National 40-50 MW data center (21st Century Economic Roadmap)
developer: Royal Government of Bhutan (GovTech Agency & DHI feasibility)
notes: asset_class=planned national/AI-ready datacenter. The Bhutanese (2025-06-28): per the 21st Century Economic Roadmap implementation plan, aim to build a 40-50 MW data center with ~USD 450M investment, construction starting 2027 lasting three years; short-term GovTech/DHI feasibility study (market, energy allocation framework, site identification) outstanding. Division TBD - do not assign a dzongkhag until official site selection/permit. B until official site evidence.

name: DHI AI Data Center proposal
notes: asset_class=planned AI/GPU infrastructure. The Bhutanese (2026-02-14) reports DHI presented a proposal at the Invest Bhutan Summit for a large-scale AI-ready data center powered entirely by renewable energy; DHI newsroom confirms DHI investment strategy framing at the Summit. Proposal/strategy stage, no site, land, permit or power allocation - status planned/proposal (A for DHI strategy, B for facility details).
